title: S5 'can I stay until Sunday?' — LIVE NL intake + RECORD return-corridor evidence through the honest authority ceiling

boundaries.note: natural-language stay-extension request interpreted by LIVE Model Studio into the frozen ChangeRequest schema; zod-validated, fail-closed on ambiguity
return-corridor planning evidence through the RECORD-mode Atlas adapter; sanitized recordings persisted

steps.description: Traveller asks in natural language to stay until Sunday; LIVE Model Studio extracts the stay extension into the frozen ChangeRequest schema

body.text: Can I stay until Sunday? Please extend my stay until 2026-10-04T12:00:00+08:00; my return flight home should depart on Sunday afternoon, after that time. I will pay for the extension myself.

assert.description: the NL stay-extension request is accepted
the request came from interpretation, not a pre-structured target
the model maps a stay extension to a stay change, not an arrival bound
a recovery case opens for the request

assert.expected: departAfter 2026-10-04T12:00:00+08:00 is 37h later than current latest departure
assert.description: the return-leg window delta is derived from authoritative trip state

assert.expected: incremental payer TRAVELLER per rule(s) rule-ait-funded-window
assert.description: the extension accrues outside the event-funded window: deterministic payer decision before pricing

steps.description: Planning re-searches the return corridor for the requested departure date (RECORD Atlas evidence) and records the stay extension honestly

assert.description: the planning loop completed against recorded return-corridor evidence
the evidence request is a flight search on the return corridor
the RECORD Atlas adapter supplied return-corridor offers
corridor offers become candidate rebook strategies
the candidate rebooks the existing return leg to a later departure
a Sunday return inside the trip window is deterministically feasible
feasible candidates are ranked into a best strategy
the case advanced through the planning stage

steps.description: Strategy becomes a money-moving intent; deterministic authority reviews gross spend and mixed funding allocates the priced cost against the funded window

assert.description: the strategy was staged as a validated action intent
mixed funding: the extension accrues outside the funded window, so the traveller pays the increment deterministically
the allocation cites the governing policy rule
the traveller-funded incremental amount is surfaced as a deterministic summary
honest authority ceiling: RECORD fails closed on SGD-limit vs USD-spend incomparability (ADR-045); REPLAY blocks on the curated SGD ceilings
a blocked intent is never executable
the blocked money-moving intent escalates the case for human review
the blocking spend-ceiling rule is named in the deterministic rule trace in both modes

steps.description: Observe the recovery case after the authority stage

assert.description: the case belongs to the requesting traveller's trip
the evaluated options remain visible on the case
